verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents recurring invoices at regular intervals, which is a recurring schedule, and separately lets you schedule an invoice to send on a chosen date, which is a one-off action. Together these give basic cycle and date control, but nothing in the evidence addresses billing anchors as such. missing for 10: calendar vs anniversary billing anchor selection, alignment or co-terming across a customer's multiple subscriptions, explicit control over recurring invoice generation dates or anchor days, proration on anchor changes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can control billing anchors and cycles — calendar vs anniversary billing, alignment across a customer's subscriptions, custom invoice dates

citations.quote: Create recurring invoices for transactions that occur at regular intervals, so you don't have to create them individually every time.
Zoho Invoice lets you schedule your invoices to be automatically sent to your customers on the date you choose.
